description: SecurityInsight_AssetTagging -- launcher for the asset-tagging engine (criticality tags; report only unless -Apply).
notes: Invokes engine/asset-tagging/AssetTagging.ps1. The only SecurityInsight engine that CAN write, and it is REPORT ONLY by default: it writes tags only with -Apply or SI_AssetTagging_Apply = $true, and then needs the write grants (opt-in in setup). Customer config layered: LauncherConfig.defaults.ps1 -> SecurityInsight.custom.ps1 (config) -> LauncherConfig.custom.ps1 -> CLI args.
author: Morten Knudsen (Invardia) <info@invardia.com>
